input.brief: An original miniature courier called Vela carries an amber lantern across a rainy rooftop to a lost paper bird. Eight shots, no logos. Mention Vela in the logline and rooftop in the visual bible. End with the bird safely sheltered. Titles and narration in English.

script.title: A Light Across the Roof
script.logline: Vela carries a failing lantern across a rainy rooftop to shelter a lost paper bird.
script.style: Original handcrafted rooftop world, indigo rain and amber practical light, tactile felt and paper, soft grain, shallow focus, no lettering or logos.

characters.description: Original adult miniature courier, round tan face, short charcoal hair, compact build, ochre rain cape and plain copper boots.
Original palm-sized folded ivory paper bird, cobalt wing tips, rounded beak, no markings.

script.music: Original instrumental chamber cue, 76 BPM, muted piano and low bowed strings, quiet urgency resolving warmly, no vocals.
script.voiceover: Vela has one light left. Beyond the rain, a small wing waits. A careful step. A shared shelter. Enough light for two.

shots.camera: Extreme wide, slow crane down, deep focus, measured pace
shots.lighting: Blue dusk key, amber lantern practical and cool rim
shots.action: Vela shields a flickering lantern and notices a pale shape across the roof.
shots.keyframe: Original compact courier Vela, tan face, short charcoal hair, ochre cape, copper boots, on wet indigo tiles with amber lantern; 24mm, blue dusk, deep focus, no writing.
shots.motion: Crane slowly down as Vela cups the amber lantern; rain trails across the same rooftop, screen movement left to right.

shots.camera: Close-up, slow dolly in, shallow f/1.4, measured pace
shots.lighting: Soft blue key and amber reflection rim
shots.action: The ivory paper bird grips a tile edge as water weighs down one cobalt wing.
shots.keyframe: Palm-sized ivory folded paper bird with cobalt wing tips crouches at a wet rooftop edge, blue dusk and amber reflection, 85mm shallow focus, no writing.
shots.motion: Dolly gently toward the bird as its wing lowers with rainwater and its feet tighten on the tile.

shots.camera: Medium tracking right, walking speed, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Amber practical key, cool rain rim
shots.action: Vela tests a loose tile, transfers weight and steps toward the bird.
shots.keyframe: Vela, tan round face, charcoal hair, ochre cape and copper boots, braces on indigo tiles holding an amber lantern, 35mm, blue dusk, no lettering.
shots.motion: Track right with Vela as one boot presses a tile, then the other advances; lantern light stays warm against the rain.

shots.camera: Insert, locked-off, shallow f/1.4, tense pause
shots.lighting: Lantern practical and cool edge light
shots.action: A tile tips under Vela's boot; a hand catches the lantern before it slides.
shots.keyframe: Plain copper boot of ochre-caped Vela on a tipping wet tile, amber lantern at frame edge, 100mm macro, cool dusk rim, no text.
shots.motion: Hold the macro camera as the boot shifts, the tile tips and Vela catches the lantern with a short controlled reach.

shots.camera: Wide, slow push-in, deep focus, kinetic into held impact
shots.lighting: Amber lantern key and blue rim
shots.action: Vela slides the lantern toward the bird and reaches across the narrow gap.
shots.vfx: Warm lantern bloom on wet tiles
shots.keyframe: Vela, original tan-faced courier in ochre cape, kneels across from ivory paper bird with cobalt tips, amber lantern between them, wet rooftop, 24mm deep focus.
shots.motion: Push in as Vela reaches right across the gap and the paper bird leans toward the offered hand; slow into the moment of contact.

shots.camera: Close-up, gentle lateral slide, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm lantern key and soft cool rim
shots.action: The bird settles into Vela's palm and folds its wet wing.
shots.keyframe: Ivory paper bird with cobalt wing tips in the open tan palm of ochre-caped courier Vela, warm lantern light, blue rooftop behind, 85mm shallow focus.
shots.motion: Slide slowly right as the bird settles its weight, folds its wing and Vela steadies the cupped palm.

shots.camera: Medium tracking right, measured pace, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm practical under awning and blue dusk rim
shots.action: Vela ducks under a plain wooden awning and lifts the bird away from the rain.
shots.keyframe: Tan-faced Vela in ochre cape carries ivory paper bird with cobalt tips beneath a plain rooftop awning, amber lantern, 50mm, soft rain bokeh, no logos.
shots.motion: Track right as Vela steps into shelter, bends both knees and gently lifts the bird to a dry ledge.

shots.camera: Wide, locked-off held final image, deep focus
shots.lighting: Amber lantern practical and cool roof rim
shots.atmosphere: Fine rain outside the dry shelter
shots.action: The bird rests beside Vela beneath the awning, both reflected in the steady lantern glass.
shots.keyframe: Vela, compact tan-faced courier in ochre cape, and ivory paper bird with cobalt tips rest beneath a plain awning beside an amber lantern, rainy indigo rooftop, 35mm, no text.
shots.motion: Hold the frame as the bird settles and Vela lowers a protective hand; the lantern stays steady while rain moves beyond the shelter.

input.brief: Une courte fiction : Mira, bibliothécaire d'un village entièrement inventé, retrouve une graine oubliée et l'offre à un enfant pour ouvrir une bibliothèque de graines. Huit plans. Le logline anglais doit mentionner Mira et seed. Cartons et voix off en français, dont le mot graine. Aucun événement réel, marque ou panneau lisible.

script.title: The Seed Shelf
script.logline: Mira finds a forgotten seed and turns an empty village shelf into a shared seed library.
script.style: Original fictional village library in cream, moss and terracotta, warm window side light, tactile paper and clay, fine film grain, no visible writing.

characters.description: Original adult librarian, olive round face, dark curly bob, average build, moss cardigan and terracotta apron, no badges.
Original school-age child, brown face, short black hair, small build, plain cream sweater and moss trousers.

script.music: Original acoustic cue, plucked strings and soft clarinet, 80 BPM, curious then hopeful, no vocals.
script.voiceover: Une graine oubliée. Mira ouvre sa main, puis une nouvelle page. Ce que nous partageons peut grandir. Aujourd'hui, une petite bibliothèque prend racine.

shots.camera: Wide, slow dolly in, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm window key and soft shelf rim
shots.action: Mira opens an unused drawer and discovers a small clay seed dish.
shots.keyframe: Original librarian Mira, olive face, dark curly bob, moss cardigan and terracotta apron, at a blank wooden drawer, cream library, 24mm warm side light, no writing.
shots.motion: Dolly slowly forward as Mira opens the drawer and pauses over a clay dish; keep window light stable.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up, locked-off, shallow f/1.4
shots.lighting: Warm side key and dish reflection rim
shots.action: Mira lifts a single seed from the dish with careful fingertips.
shots.keyframe: Mira's olive fingertips beside a single seed in a clay dish, moss sleeve, cream library background, 100mm macro, warm side light, no text.
shots.motion: Hold as fingertips approach, lift the seed and open into a steady palm.

shots.camera: Medium, slow lateral slide, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm window key and soft hair rim
shots.action: The child notices the seed and sets an empty pot on the table.
shots.keyframe: Original brown-faced child with short black hair, cream sweater and moss trousers, carrying a plain empty pot in a warm cream library, 50mm, no writing.
shots.motion: Slide right as the child steps to the table and lowers the pot with both hands.

shots.camera: Medium two-shot, slow push-in, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm key and reflected cream fill
shots.action: Mira offers the seed, then hesitates over the child's empty pot.
shots.keyframe: Mira, olive face and curly bob in moss cardigan, faces brown-faced child in cream sweater across a pot, open hand with seed, 35mm warm library light.
shots.motion: Push gently toward both hands as Mira extends her palm and the child tilts the empty pot to show it.

shots.camera: Close-up, slow dolly in, shallow f/1.4
shots.lighting: Warm window key and soft skin rim
shots.action: The child steadies Mira's hand, and together they place the seed into the pot.
shots.keyframe: Olive hand in moss sleeve and small brown hands in cream sleeves above a clay pot with seed, warm library window, 85mm shallow focus.
shots.motion: Dolly in as the child steadies Mira's hand and both lower the seed into the pot; slow into the shared gesture.

shots.camera: Insert, locked-off, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Soft warm side key and pot rim
shots.action: Mira adds a little soil and brushes the pot's rim clean.
shots.keyframe: Mira's moss sleeve and olive hands beside a clay pot, loose soil on a plain wood table, 100mm macro, warm side light, no lettering.
shots.motion: Hold as soil falls, Mira brushes the rim and the pot settles on the table.

shots.camera: Wide, slow tracking right, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm window key and cream bounce
shots.action: Mira and the child carry the pot to an empty low shelf and add blank seed envelopes.
shots.keyframe: Original Mira in moss cardigan and terracotta apron beside brown-faced child in cream sweater, both holding clay pot near empty shelf, 24mm cream library, no writing.
shots.motion: Track right with both characters as they lower the pot and arrange blank envelopes beside it.

shots.camera: Medium wide, locked-off held final image, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm window key and gentle rim
shots.action: Mira and the child share a proud nod beside the new seed shelf.
shots.keyframe: Mira, olive face, curly bob and moss cardigan, and original brown-faced child in cream sweater beside clay pot and blank envelopes, 35mm warm library light, no text.
shots.motion: Hold the final frame as Mira and the child nod to one another, then rest their hands beside the pot.

input.brief: A silent original object film about a small wind-up crab repairing a jammed toy bridge for a rolling wooden marble. Exactly ten three-second shots, no narration or captions. Keep voiceover empty and titles empty. Mention crab in the logline. No real designs, logos, brands or text.

script.title: The Little Bridge
script.logline: An original wind-up crab repairs a toy bridge so a wooden marble can reach its resting place.
script.style: Handmade original tabletop world in copper, walnut and cream, warm soft side light, macro textures, plain objects with no writing or branded shapes.

characters.description: Original walnut wind-up crab, six short copper legs, two rounded wooden claws, plain brass key, no face or markings.

script.music: Original playful pizzicato strings and muted wood percussion, 96 BPM, no vocals.

shots.camera: Wide, slow dolly in, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm side key and soft rim
shots.action: A wooden marble rolls toward a raised toy bridge and stops.
shots.keyframe: Plain walnut marble before original miniature raised wooden bridge, copper hinge, cream table, 24mm warm side light, no writing.
shots.motion: Dolly gently in as the marble rolls right and stops at the gap.

shots.camera: Medium tracking right, measured pace, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm key and copper rim
shots.action: The wind-up crab approaches the stalled marble.
shots.keyframe: Original walnut wind-up crab, six copper legs, rounded claws and plain brass key, beside wooden marble, cream tabletop, 50mm warm light.
shots.motion: Track right as the crab's legs alternately grip and release the table toward the marble.

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off, shallow f/1.4
shots.lighting: Warm key and soft edge light
shots.action: The crab taps the marble, then turns toward the bridge hinge.
shots.keyframe: Walnut crab with copper legs and rounded claw beside plain wooden marble, brass key, 85mm macro-like framing, warm cream tabletop.
shots.motion: Hold as the rounded claw touches the marble and the crab shifts its body toward the hinge.

shots.camera: Insert, slow push-in, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm grazing key and copper rim
shots.action: The crab discovers a wooden splinter blocking the hinge.
shots.keyframe: Rounded walnut claw and copper bridge hinge blocked by a wood splinter, cream table, 100mm macro, warm grazing light, no markings.
shots.motion: Push slowly toward the hinge as the claw tests the obstruction once.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm side key and soft rim
shots.action: The crab grips the splinter, braces its legs and slips backward.
shots.keyframe: Original walnut crab with six copper legs braced beside raised bridge, rounded claws on wood splinter, plain brass key, 50mm warm side light.
shots.motion: Hold as legs brace, claws pull and the crab slides back slightly without falling.

shots.camera: Close-up, quick push-in slowing at impact, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm key and bright copper rim
shots.action: The crab plants all six legs and pulls the splinter free.
shots.keyframe: Walnut crab with rounded claws gripping splinter, six copper legs planted, brass key, original toy bridge, 85mm warm side light.
shots.motion: Push in as the crab shifts its weight and pulls; slow at the instant the splinter releases.

shots.camera: Wide, slow crane down, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm window key and soft bridge rim
shots.action: The bridge lowers until its deck meets the tabletop.
shots.keyframe: Original miniature bridge lowering beside walnut crab with copper legs and brass key, plain wooden marble waiting left, cream table, 24mm warm light.
shots.motion: Crane gently down with the bridge deck as the crab guides its edge into place.

shots.camera: Medium tracking right, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm key and soft copper rim
shots.action: The crab nudges the marble onto the repaired bridge.
shots.keyframe: Walnut wind-up crab, rounded claws and copper legs, behind wooden marble at repaired bridge, plain brass key, 35mm warm cream tabletop.
shots.motion: Track right as one rounded claw nudges the marble and it begins rolling across the deck.

shots.camera: Insert, locked-off, shallow focus
shots.lighting: Warm side key and wood rim
shots.action: The marble rolls into a shallow wooden resting cup.
shots.keyframe: Plain walnut marble at rim of shallow original wooden cup, cream table, 100mm macro, warm side light, no markings.
shots.motion: Hold as the marble rolls into the cup, circles once and slows.

shots.camera: Wide, locked-off held final image, deep focus
shots.lighting: Warm soft key and brass key rim
shots.action: The crab rests beside the repaired bridge while the marble settles in its cup.
shots.keyframe: Original walnut crab with six copper legs, rounded claws and plain brass key beside repaired toy bridge, wooden marble in cup, 35mm warm cream tabletop, no writing.
shots.motion: Hold as the crab folds its claws and the marble becomes still in its cup.
